verse.verse_1: By the heaven and the Morning Star
verse.verse_2: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
verse.verse_4: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
verse.verse_5: So let man consider from what he is created.
verse.verse_6: He is created from a gushing fluid
verse.verse_7: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
verse.verse_8: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
verse.verse_9: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
verse.verse_10: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
verse.verse_11: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
verse.verse_12: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
verse.verse_13: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
verse.verse_15: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
verse.verse_16: And I plot a plot (against them).
verse.verse_17: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
